scientific_integrity: The formulas follow from a complete second-residue-baseline proof for every integer k>=0. Finite checks independently support but do not establish the universal assertions. The source paper supplies the template families; no claims of independent evaluation are made.
scientific_limitations: Only the one-Frobenius number p=1 for the two specified infinite templates is proved. No assertion of the infinitude of prime triplets or coverage of p>=2; equivalent independent formulas outside inspected literature remain possible.
title: Exact one-Frobenius numbers for both prime-triplet templates
